items.passage: A standard measure is usually treated as a technical matter, but its deeper effect was social. Before a measure was fixed, every trade needed an argument about the quantity itself. Such arguments were settled by local standing rather than by any shared rule. A trader moving between towns therefore carried not only goods but a running dispute about what a container actually held. Every such dispute had to be reopened in the next town he entered, and the cost of reopening it fell on the goods themselves. Once a single measure was fixed, that dispute disappeared, and the special skill of the people who had settled such disputes disappeared with it. Historians of trade often treat that skill as a casualty of progress, yet the exchange was never a simple loss. What replaced local judgement was a rule that strangers could check without trusting each other. Checking at a distance is exactly what allowed trade to reach beyond people one already knew.
choices: the condition under which early inspectors judged a container
differences among the containers that each town once held
reasons why trade among strangers stayed rare in every period
a fixed measure as the condition for dealing among strangers
methods by which a container was measured before the reform

items.passage: The first fixed measures were kept as physical objects in a public building. A bar of metal or a carved stone served as the object against which officials compared local containers. A copy of that object was then sent to each market town for daily use. The copies drifted a little every year, because metal wore down and stone chipped at the edges. Inspectors travelled between the towns to correct the drift in those copies. That work was slow, and the corrections were often disputed by local traders. A single worn copy could shift the price of grain across a whole region. Later the measure was tied to a natural constant rather than to any object. A wavelength of light does not wear down and needs no inspector. Any laboratory can reproduce the measure without a visit from an official. The metal bar became a museum piece rather than a working authority.
choices: 최초의 고정 도량형은 실물로 보관되었다.
